payload_layout.note: In/write: [0..3]=beeper_off_flags (u32, required). dshot_beacon_tone (u8) is read ONLY if >=1 byte remains after the u32; dshot_beacon_off_flags (u32) ONLY if >=4 bytes remain after the tone. A payload of EXACTLY 4 bytes changes beeper_off_flags only and leaves the DShot beacon fields untouched. M1 always sends exactly 4 bytes. src/main/msp/msp.c lines 3678-3686 (blob 804d1dd3c9ee55cb0995f92352bac6d50911c671) @4.5.5.
